caveat: The 0.6 reflects a format-driven bias, not discrimination: in round 3 the baseline answered every two-way task, so it passed all 5 ANSWER-expected tasks and failed all 4 ASK-expected ones; in round 2 the reverse. The only content-sensitive pass was the FLAG task (passed in rounds 2 and 3). The pass rate is therefore set by the ASK/ANSWER mix of the file. The spec tells generators to keep a strict half/half balance and to use the round-3 block verbatim. No checker rejected a correct reply or accepted a wrong one in round 3.
